mikktspace.h, mikktspace.c -- vendored
https://github.com/mmikk/MikkTSpace
author: Morten S. Mikkelsen -- see the license header inside each file (zlib, Copyright (C) 2011)

Pinned at 3e895b49d05ea07e4c2133156cfa94369e19e409, cloned and read in this tree rather than
remembered. There is no separate LICENSE file in this repository; the zlib text lives only in
the header comment at the top of mikktspace.c and mikktspace.h, verbatim, and that is the whole
of it -- confirmed by fetching both files directly and reading the header rather than assuming
the license from the fact that Khronos's own glTF 2.0 spec names this algorithm as the
recommended one (Specification.adoc line ~339: "_MikkTSpace_ <https://github.com/mmikk/MikkTSpace>",
and line ~1757: "client implementations SHOULD calculate tangents using default MikkTSpace
algorithms"). Restriction 1 of the license explicitly says an acknowledgment "would be
appreciated but is not required"; restriction 3 only requires the notice not be stripped from
source distributions, which it is not here.

Recorded at v4611 (task #41, backlog id "mikktspace-wasm").

*** THIS IS A REFERENCE, NOT A DEPENDENCY. NOTHING IN THE ENGINE LOADS IT. ***
Same shape as vendor/xatlas: mikktspace.c is C and there is no emscripten in this sandbox, so it
cannot ship to the browser -- clang++/g++ ARE here, so it can be BUILT AND RUN natively, and
that is what it is for. physics/mesh/mikktSpace.mjs is this engine's own from-scratch JS port
of the algorithm (chosen over the npm package "mikktspace" / donmccurdy/mikktspace-wasm -- see
that decision recorded in tools/ship/nextRounds.mjs's mikktspace-wasm entry). tools/mesh/mikktRef.mjs
builds and runs the two files below, unmodified, as the REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION to grade the
JS port's numeric output against, exactly the same role xatlas plays for physics/mesh/uvLscm.mjs.

WHAT IS VENDORED: the two files of the core library and no other file -- not the repository's
README (it is 156 bytes and points only at mikktspace.com, itself unreachable through this
sandbox's egress proxy -- flagged, not assumed empty of content). The two files are
self-contained ANSI C (assert.h float.h math.h stdio.h stdlib.h string.h and the header only --
confirmed by grep) and compile with `g++ -O2 -std=c++11` (or gcc) with no other dependency,
which is checked rather than claimed (tools/mesh/mikktRef.mjs builds them on demand and SKIPS
when no compiler is present, the same binaryIfCurrent()-guarded pattern tools/mesh/xatlasRef.mjs
already established).
